bot.description: Show whether the Keeper answers, or (room admin) mute or unmute it.
bot.event_off: The Keeper is muted; the table plays on.
bot.title: Keeper on/off
check.description: Roll a skill or ability check with your character, graded by the room's rule system. A number after the skill is this check's target; b/p add bonus/penalty dice; the system's difficulty words apply.
check.title: Check
check.usage: .ra [N#] [b|p] [difficulty] <skill> [target] — e.g. .ra spot hidden, .ra 侦查60, .ra b2 hard 侦查
chronicle.description: The campaign chronicle: the records, the rolling summary, the open threads, and the Keeper's margin note. Only you see the answer.
chronicle.no_summary: No campaign summary exists yet — the first fold creates it.
chronicle.title: Chronicle
draw.description: Draw a card from a shuffled deck.
draw.title: Draw a card
error.bad_bundle: That is not a room bundle this server can load ({path}).
error.card_bad_name: The card has no usable name: give one (.import character <file hash> <name>).
error.card_unreadable: The card {card} could not be read from its pack.
error.command_failed: Something went wrong running that command; nothing was changed.
error.directive_too_long: The card's standing instructions are too long ({path}).
error.document_refused: The change was refused: it would store invalid data.
error.document_unreadable: Stored data is damaged and was left untouched.
error.entry_invalid: A lore entry of the card is not valid ({path}).
error.forbidden: That is for the room admin.
error.init_empty: No one is in the initiative order.
error.key_has_space: "{key}" is not a stat name; set one stat at a time, e.g. STR=60.
error.limit_reached: The room is at its limit for that.
error.lore_full: The room would hold more lore entries than it may.
error.module_args: A module command takes its arguments as a JSON object.
error.module_id_taken: A pack enabled here already has a module called {module}.
error.module_variables_full: The room cannot declare another variable ({detail}).
error.name_too_long: The card's name is too long.
error.no_character: You are not playing a character. Make one (.coc, .dnd) or claim one (.pc).
error.no_initiative_roll: This rule system declares no initiative roll; give a value (.init <value>).
error.no_media: This server keeps no files: uploads and imports are not available.
error.no_member: Only a member of the room can do that.
error.no_modifier: This rule system has no bonus or penalty dice.
error.no_rule_system: This room has no rule system with checks.
error.no_summary: No campaign summary exists yet — the first fold creates it.
error.no_variables: This room has no imported variables.
error.not_a_card: That file is not a card this server can read ({code}).
error.not_in_system: .{word} is not part of this room's rule system.
error.not_numeric: {skill} is not a number on this sheet.
error.not_uploaded: You have not uploaded a file with that hash for import. Upload the card first.
error.not_your_character: That character is not yours to change.
error.opening_too_long: An opening of the card is too long ({path}).
error.pack_missing: The rule system of that character is not installed.
error.pack_not_enabled: The pack {id} is not enabled in this room.
error.panel_not_available: No panel {id} in the packs enabled here.
error.persona_too_long: The character's description is too long.
error.prose_too_long: A text of the card is too long ({path}).
error.reset_not_armed: No reset is waiting for your confirmation: send .reset first.
error.reset_scope_mismatch: The reset you armed clears {scope}; confirm that one, or arm another.
error.roll_failed: The rule system could not roll that ({code}).
error.sheet_refused: The sheet could not be saved ({code}).
error.skill_not_available: This room has no skill {id} to enable.
error.stale_generation: The room changed meanwhile (it was rewound, reset or replaced). Try again.
error.too_many_entries: The card's lorebook has more entries than one import takes.
error.too_many_inline_rolls: Too many inline rolls in one line (limit {limit}); none were rolled.
error.too_many_openings: The card has too many openings.
error.too_many_packs: A room enables at most {limit} packs.
error.too_many_skills: Too many skills are enabled here; disable one first.
error.too_many_writes: Too many values in one command (limit {limit}).
error.undo_beyond_depth: Undo reaches back at most {depth} turns.
error.undo_out_of_range: There is no earlier turn to go back to.
error.unknown_character: No character called {name} is on offer.
error.unknown_difficulty: This rule system has no difficulty {difficulty}.
error.unknown_pack: No pack {id} is installed on this server.
error.unknown_skill: Nothing on the sheet is called {skill}.
error.use_release: That character belongs to the room's roster: release it (.pc release) instead of deleting it.
error.variables_too_large: The card's variables would make the room's variable tree too large ({detail}).
error.wrong_system: Your character belongs to another rule system ({system}).
habits.description: What the Keeper has learned about how this table plays; forget one that is wrong.
habits.empty: Nothing learned yet — habits appear once the same thing has been seen a few times.
habits.title: Table habits
help.description: The commands you can use here, or one command in detail.
help.player_hint: The commands for running the table are in the room admin's hands.
help.title: Help
hidden_roll.description: Roll dice where only you see the result; the table is not told a roll was made.
hidden_roll.title: Hidden roll
import.character_world_card: This is a world card: only its character came along; its world waits for the room admin's world import.
import.description: Bring in a card — a file you uploaded for import, or one a pack enabled here ships: as the room's world (room admin), or as your character.
import.recall_failed: Indexing the lore for recall failed ({code}); the entries still activate by keyword.
import.skipped_long: {count} lore entries were too long and were left out.
import.title: Import a card
import.unreachable: {count} lore entries are disabled and have no keywords: nothing activates them until you bind them (.lore).
import.unreadable_declarations: {count} variable declarations could not be read.
import.usage: .import world <file hash> | .import character <file hash> [name] | .import world <pack> <card path> | .import character <pack> <card path> [name]
import.world_done: Imported the world {name}: {lore} lore entries ({secret} secret), {variables} variable declarations, {openings} openings.
import.world_redone: Re-imported the world {name}: {lore} lore entries ({secret} secret) replace the {replaced} it had, {variables} variable declarations, {openings} openings.
import.world_stacked: The room now holds {count} world cards: their lore and standing instructions stack.
init.cleared: The fight is over: initiative cleared.
init.description: Show the initiative order, roll your character's initiative, pass the turn, or end the fight.
init.empty: No one is in the initiative order.
init.title: Initiative
jrrp.description: Your luck for today: the same number all day.
jrrp.title: Today's luck
language.description: Set the language the room is played in.
language.event: This room is now played in English.
language.title: Room language
lore.description: List the room's lore. The room admin also adds entries and switches imported ones on, off, or behind a condition.
lore.restored: Removed {count} annotation(s); those entries follow their file again.
lore.title: Lore
lore.usage: .lore [list] | add <title> | <content> | enable <title> | disable <title> | bind <title> | <condition> | unbind <title> | restore <title|*> | list disabled
new_character.description: Make a new character in a rule system with its creation word (.coc, .dnd) and play it.
new_character.title: New character
npc.description: List the room's NPCs, read one's whole record, or delete one. Only you see the answer.
npc.title: NPCs
opposed.description: Two checks against each other, settled the way the room's rule system settles a contest.
opposed.title: Opposed check
opposed.usage: .rav <skill>[, <other skill>] — a number after a skill states that side's value
pack.assets_failed: {count} of its pictures or sounds could not be stored as room media.
pack.description: See the content packs this room plays with; the room admin sees every installed pack and enables or disables them here.
pack.none_enabled: No packs are enabled in this room.
pack.none_installed: No packs are installed on this server. The operator installs them from the shell (loreweaver install).
pack.part_shadowed: not loaded, an earlier one keeps the id: {list}
pack.skills_available: Its skills can now be enabled: {list} (.skill enable <id>).
pack.skills_dropped: Its skills were disabled with it: {list}.
pack.title: Packs
panels.description: See the panels of the packs this room plays with; the room admin switches each one on or off here.
panels.header_admin: Panels of the packs enabled here:
panels.title: Panels
pc.description: List the characters this room offers, claim one to play it, or release it again.
pc.empty: This room offers no characters to claim.
pc.title: Character roster
reason.no_rule_system: this room has no rule system with checks
reason.not_in_system: the room's rule system has no such rule
reason.observer: observers watch; they do not play
recap.empty: No story yet — the story so far will appear here once the campaign gets going.
recap.title: Recap
rename.title: Rename
reset.armed: This will permanently clear {what}. Room settings stay. Send .reset confirm within {seconds}s to proceed.
reset.description: Restart the campaign in place: story only (default), also the characters, or everything. Then confirm.
reset.scope.all: everything: characters, the world, its lore, and the story
reset.scope.chars: the story and the characters (the world and its lore stay)
reset.scope.story: the story and progress (your characters, the world and its lore stay)
reset.title: Reset
roll.description: Roll a dice expression for the table to see. A comparison straight after a dice group counts the dice that meet it (5d10>=7); compare a total in parentheses ((5d10)>6). d% is a d100. N# rolls N times; adv/dis keeps the better or worse of two.
roll.title: Roll dice
rule.description: Show the room's rule system and house-rule ladder, or (room admin) choose another.
rule.stale: The stored ladder no longer exists in this room's rule system; checks grade by the default until another is set.
rule.title: House rule
rules.check_with_loss.description: Roll {name}: a check against the stat, then the loss for the outcome.
rules.check_with_loss.title: {name}
rules.improvement_check.description: Roll {name} for a skill: a roll above its value grows it.
rules.improvement_check.title: {name}
rules.opposed.description: Run {name}: two checks against each other.
rules.opposed.title: {name}
rules.table_draw.title: {name}
save.description: Export the whole room as a bundle, or replace the room with one.
save.exported: Exported the room: {documents} documents, {events} log entries.
save.imported: Loaded the bundle; the room continues from turn {turn}.
save.title: Save
sheet.corrected: {count} value(s) were brought into the rule system's ranges.
sheet.description: Show your sheet, or set values on it: NAME=VALUE (also += and -=), or the dice-bot form NAME VALUE. A value may be dice. clear deletes your character; finalize resets its current pools for its final characteristics.
sheet.finalized: {name} finalized: current values set for the final characteristics.
sheet.title: Character sheet
sheet.usage: .st [show] | .st STR=60 HP-=2 | .st 力量60 敏捷50 | .st clear | .st finalize
skill.description: List the Keeper skills this room can enable — the built-in ones and those of its enabled packs — and switch them on or off.
skill.title: Keeper skills
undo.description: Rewind the room by one or more turns.
undo.done: Rewound {turns} turn(s); the room is back at the end of turn {turn}.
undo.title: Undo
uploads.description: Show whether members may upload files to this room, or (room admin) allow or stop uploads.
uploads.event_on: Uploads are open: members may share files.
uploads.status_off: Uploads are off in this room.
uploads.status_on: Members may upload files to this room.
uploads.title: Uploads on/off
var.description: The room's variables: list them, show a branch to the players or hide it again, set or adjust a value.
var.title: Variables
